name: Senir's Observations
summary: Grelin Whitebeard's report now travels from Coldridge Valley to Senir in Kharanos. Its findings carry news of the valley's threats beyond the sheltered training grounds of Anvilmar.

sections.title: Through the Tunnel to Kharanos
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard has recovered his stolen journal from the Frostmane trolls and prepared a report on the valley's threats for his brother Senir. Mountaineer Thalos guards the gate out of Coldridge Valley and gives the dispatch to travelers passing through. The route leads through a mountain tunnel recently overrun by violent troggs that ambush anyone crossing. Beyond it, the main road runs through central Dun Morogh to Kharanos.

sections.title: A Grumpy Welcome and Senate Politics
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard is warming himself over drinks at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos when Grelin's report arrives. He chuckles at his brother's forceful words. Grelin invokes King Magni Bronzebeard to press for urgent action, and Senir says the tactic is bound to agitate the stubborn Ironforge Senate. Senir admits the bitter cold has kept him from filing his own observations. Grelin's dispatch spurs him back to his duties, watching hostile forces across the snowfields.

faq.q: Why is Mountaineer Thalos having a traveler deliver the report?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos guards the Coldridge Valley tunnel against aggressive troggs and cannot leave his post. When a traveler passes through, he entrusts them with carrying Grelin's dispatch to Kharanos.
Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven scout and Grelin Whitebeard's brother. He is stationed in Kharanos, where he gathers field reports on local threats for the high command in Ironforge.

Grelin's report records his findings on Frostmane troll activity and incursions in Coldridge Valley. He invokes King Magni Bronzebeard's authority to press the authorities for reinforcements and attention.

faq.q: Why does Senir say Grelin's report will ruffle feathers in the Senate?
faq.answer: Grelin invokes King Magni's name forcefully to demand action. That can challenge the Ironforge Senate's authority and pride, irritating members who favor formal deliberation.

faq.q: Why is the tunnel between Coldridge Valley and Kharanos dangerous?
aliases: why are troggs in the tunnel
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs have emerged from deep subterranean cracks and seized the mountain tunnel. They attack dwarven travelers, merchants, and messengers who try to pass.

faq.q: Where does the road lead after delivering this message?
faq.answer: Kharanos brings travelers into the wider defense of Dun Morogh. Senir Whitebeard seeks help investigating Frostmane and trogg threats, while town leaders direct aid toward Brewnall Village, Ironforge, and the outlying farms.

angles.text: For a dwarf, leaving the sheltered training valley for Kharanos marks a first step into Khaz Modan's defense, where field scouts' concerns meet the Ironforge Senate's caution.
For a gnome, the pass to Kharanos brings you closer to Dun Morogh's main hubs and the efforts to support your dwarven hosts.
Coordinated scouting helps keep Dun Morogh secure while Stormwind is caught up in domestic strife and cannot spare aid for its northern allies.
